sourceRefs.locator: A Note on Genealogy and IV.27–28, 51: Chlothar’s sons, the marriages of Sigibert and Chilperic, and the death of Sigibert.
IX.20, Copy of the Agreement, preamble and clauses on Paris, Clodechild, Childebert’s children, Faileuba, Chlodosind, Galswinth’s cities, the leudes, travel and oaths.

summary.de: Bruder Sigiberts und Chilperichs. Er vereinbarte mit seinem Neffen Childebert II. und dessen Mutter in Andelot Regelungen über Erbschaft und gegenseitige Hilfe.
summary.en: Brother of Sigibert and Chilperic. At Andelot he agreed with his nephew Childebert II and the latter’s mother on succession and mutual support.
